description: Ministry of Lands - Appoint Land Acquisition Officers
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically concerns the appointment and extension of service of acquisition officers for various expressway and road expansion projects, which falls under land-related administrative matters. While it mentions government officials (the Minister and appointed officers), the core content focuses on land acquisition processes and property matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
